newsitem.title: USA: Ulysses Internatl Resources names new lineup.
newsitem.headline: Ulysses Internatl Resources names new lineup.

text.p: Ulysses International Resources Ltd said Wednesday that company president, chief executive, director and co-chairman Anthony Pike will be stepping down as part of a restructuring.
It said A. Economos, a New York-based international fund manager, was named a director and chairman of the board.
Seval Oz and Demetrius Iatridis have stepped down by the board, the company added. R. Eberley was named to fill a seat on the board.
The company said it will make other appointments soon.
